name: io.github.TMHSDigital/local-ai-mcp
title: Local AI MCP
description: Run, fit, and route work to local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, MLX, vLLM, and more).

environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_MODEL_RUNNER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Docker Model Runner host TCP endpoint

environmentVariables.name: VLLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for VLLM_HOST (when vLLM runs with --api-key)

environmentVariables.name: FOUNDRY_LOCAL_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Foundry Local service URL (opt-in; port from `foundry service status`)

environmentVariables.name: MOONSHOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Moonshot AI (Kimi) key. Hosted: only used when named explicitly.

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK
environmentVariables.description: Allow implicit routing to hosted providers (default: off)

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_AI_DISABLE
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated provider names to skip probing

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_AI_PROVIDERS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of extra provider instances: {type, host, name?, apiKey?, kind?}

environmentVariables.name: LOCAL_AI_BENCHMARK_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Benchmark results file used to rank delegate by measured speed (default: per-user cache dir; off disables)
